fields.statement: Profiling 'rhiza change show' on this repo (2,539 log entries) shows ~5 s of CPU spent reading the log (each entry decoded and re-canonicalized) and ~1.5 s folding it, every time. Drivers run in-process polls plus a 'rhiza ship check --settled' subprocess every 10 s, and 'rhiza apply' pays the full read per call. How should model reads be made cheap?
